source: XDA thread 4762900 (R0rt1z2), browser download (XDA's CDN refuses scripts)

parts.part: amonet/brom-payload/build/payload.bin and pl.bin, both built from amonet's brom-payload, which links idmetool's idmelib and carries Marco Paland's printf.c

kaeru's code in amonet/bin/checkers-kaeru.bin: every SPDX header in kaeru's source at this commit (which files this board's build pulls in is not checked); files without a header fall under its LICENSE
parts.spdx: AGPL-3.0-or-later AND MIT AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception) AND (BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-or-later) AND Unlicense AND (0BSD OR Unlicense)

parts.part: Amazon/MediaTek boot chain: amonet/bin/preloader.img, lk.bin, tz.img, tee-payload.bin, and the stock LK that checkers-kaeru.bin patches. Not in the amonet repo; the zip carries no licence or notice file
amonet/bin/twrp.img and amonet/bin/fastbrick.img and fastbrick-20240709.img: prebuilt images with no licence or notice file
amonet/bin/fastboot, fastboot32, fastboot.exe, AdbWinApi.dll, AdbWinUsbApi.dll: prebuilt Android platform tools with no licence or notice file

amonet's shell, bat and ps1 scripts, device.prop, profile.sh, profile.ps1 and META-INF's update-binary and updater-script: the repo has LICENSE.MIT and LICENSE.GPL2, but the README gives them only to modules, pl-payload, brom-payload and idmetool

notes: Needed only by units first unlocked with Amonet 1.x (boot starts with "microloader by xyz"): flashing this zip in TWRP moves them to the 2.x layout (jarvis-show.py amonet-upgrade). Unlocking checkers from stock is refused: its unlock members are not pinned here. Reviewed 2026-10-09: update-binary is byte-identical to R0rt1z2/amonet mt8163-echo-show HEAD, the other scripts match upstream (main.py/common.py as of 999f8d0ab5), fastbrick.sh and fastboot(32) are the same bytes as crown's pinned ones, device.prop says checkers, and twrp.img is the 16.1.0-20260812-checkers build. Preloader, LK, TZ and kaeru exist only in this zip.
